All 7 tests pass now.

The fix is in `src/ledger/promos.py`. `discount_total` now rounds the promo discount once, on the invoice subtotal. Before, it rounded each line and summed the results.

For INV-3041, per-line rounding gave a discount of 10566 cents. Rounding once on the 142800-cent subtotal gives 10567. That makes the total 142800 − 10567 + 2642 + 250 = 135125, which matches the 1351.25 payment the test expects.

`ZERO` and `Money` are still imported in `promos.py` but no longer used. I left them alone.

`src/ledger/rules.py` still has the uncommitted change from before this session. I read it and it looks unrelated to this fix, but I haven't looked at the diff. The `promos.py` change is also uncommitted.
